families.rationale: The title establishes workflow-grounded financial research, but it does not identify a catalogue division or a buy-side versus sell-side operating unit.
The card does not name facing, task-family boundaries, or exclusions needed to distinguish sell-side research from buy-side investment analysis.
No mapping is promoted from the generic terms finance, financial research, benchmark, or agents without an operational-unit match.
Removing the public title and repository URL leaves no evidence for any division binding, so no residual intuition supports a mapping.
An outsider can reproduce the non-promotion from the card and catalogue because the card supplies no division-facing or terminal-task detail.

notes: No mapping is promoted. The closest lexical candidate is sellside_research, but the inventory card says only financial research and does not establish sell-side facing; buy-side investment analysis is also not excluded.
